label: CD4-positive, alpha-beta memory follicular helper T cell
evidence: Azimuth human_tonsil_v2 fine label (order 51) built on King HW et al. 2021 Sci Immunol (DOI 10.1126/sciimmunol.abh3768, PMID 34623901). The label denotes a memory-phenotype CD4+ alpha-beta T follicular helper (Tfh) cell. Tfh identity (CXCR5, PD-1, ICOS, BCL6; follicle/germinal-centre localisation) and the existence of a persisting CXCR5+ memory Tfh compartment are well established in the human tonsil literature (Schaerli et al. 2000; Brenna et al. 2020; Hale & Ahmed 2015; Asrir et al. 2017).
